test_DiscreteGaussianSchedule_q_sample: test the DiscreteGaussianSchedule q_sample method to verify noisy sample generation at given timesteps
test_DiscreteGaussianSchedule_q_posterio: test the DiscreteGaussianSchedule q_posterior method to verify posterior mean and log variance computation
